title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 15, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.0 (Peaked November 15, 2026 at 13:15 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 348 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Quiet one right now. 🖤✨

Several modest active regions are visible across the Sun today, while the overall solar appearance remains relatively quiet.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
